invariants.rationale: The returned iterator of List<WriteStatus> should never be null regardless of the control flow.
If the input iterator has data, the returned iterator should yield at least one result; otherwise, it may still return an iterator over an empty or singleton list.
If there are records to update (recordItr.hasNext()), a valid fileId must be provided.
The partitionPath parameter is always required for update handling.
The fileId parameter is necessary for processing both empty and non-empty buckets.
